rows.note: Use this for emotional or figurative hurt; it is the usual noun when someone or something has been hurt psychologically.

example.english: What they said caused me a lot of harm.
example.traditional: 佢嗰句說話對我造成好大傷害。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6 deoi3 ngo5 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 soeng1 hoi6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something physical is damaged or made unusable.

example.english: If you harm the phone like this, it’ll be a real hassle.
example.traditional: 你咁樣整壞部電話，真係好麻煩。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zing2 waai6 bou6 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this for harming a person, the body, feelings, or an abstract human concern rather than simply breaking an object.

example.english: Talking like that can harm other people’s feelings.
example.traditional: 你咁樣講會傷害人哋感情㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 wui5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4 dei6 gam2 cing4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the harm damages a system, structure, environment, or relationship, especially through deliberate disruption.

example.english: Littering carelessly will harm the environment.
example.traditional: 亂咁掟垃圾會破壞環境。
example.jyutping: lyun6 gam2 deng3 laap6 saap3 wui5 po3 waai6 waan4 ging2

rows.note: Use this formal choice for damage to rights, interests, reputation, or other abstract matters.

example.english: This policy may harm citizens’ rights and interests.
example.traditional: 呢項政策可能損害市民權益。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 ho2 nang4 syun2 hoi6 si5 man4 kyun4 jik1

rows.note: Use this for harm as a disadvantage or bad effect, especially when saying that something does or does not have harmful consequences.

example.english: Staying up late for a long time causes harm to your health.
example.traditional: 長期捱夜對身體有害處。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 ngaai4 je6 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hoi6 cyu3

rows.note: Use this for material or property damage rather than a bodily wound.

example.english: The typhoon caused serious harm to buildings along the coast.
example.traditional: 颱風對沿岸建築物造成嚴重損害。
example.jyutping: toi4 fung1 deoi3 jyun4 ngon6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 zou6 sing4 jim4 zung6 syun2 hoi6

rows.note: Use this for physical injury, such as a wound or bodily hurt; use 損害 for damage to possessions.

example.english: The wound on my leg is still causing me harm.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 ge3 soeng1 zung6 tung3 gan2
